name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Georgia. It condemns the detention of opposition politician Elene Khoshtaria and others held for speaking out or protesting. It calls for their release, for an investigation into ill-treatment in custody, and for the repeal of laws used to silence dissent. It also asks the European Union and its member states to impose sanctions and a visa ban on those responsible.

- The Parliament asks for Khoshtaria and other political prisoners to be freed and charges dropped.
- It asks the EU to sanction Georgian officials behind the arrests and ban their visas.
- It urges Georgia to repeal restrictive laws; the Parliament cannot force this.
